annotations.title: Book and pay for a ride

description: Book an airport transfer and pay for it now with a Stripe shared payment token (spt_...) the traveller approved, for example from their Link wallet. CHARGES the traveller. Before calling: get the exact price with get_transfer_quote, tell the traveller the price and the cancellation terms (get_booking_terms), and get their explicit yes; pass that price as approved_total_usd. Needs every flight number and time the ride has, and the traveller's name, email and phone. An identical ride that is already paid is reported, never charged twice. Returns the booking reference; the confirmation email follows.

approved_total_usd.description: The total in USD the traveller approved; must equal the price from get_transfer_quote

arrival_at.description: Flight arrival at MBJ, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" Jamaica time

departure_at.description: Hotel pickup for the flight home, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" Jamaica time. If you only know the flight time, pass departure_flight_at instead

departure_flight_at.description: Flight home departs MBJ, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" Jamaica time; pickup is set 3 hours 30 minutes earlier

destination.description: Hotel or villa name, or id from find_transfer_destination

guest.description: The traveller the booking is for

email.description: Where the confirmation and driver details are sent

phone.description: Mobile number with country code, e.g. +1 305 555 0142

shared_payment_token.description: Stripe shared payment token (spt_...) granted to MAPL Tours Jamaica for at least this amount in USD

special_requests.description: Optional note for the driver, e.g. a car seat

name: book_and_pay_transfer
title: Book and pay for a ride
